The '''Federal Constitution of 1949''' was the founding constitutional framework of the postwar [[Belcanto Nations]]. It was adopted after the [[Declaration of Belcantese Independence]] and the collapse of Vesperan occupation.

== Purpose ==

The constitution balanced national coordination with regional autonomy. It drew on older Belcantese federal traditions while creating modern institutions capable of reconstruction, border administration, public education, and economic recovery.

== Institutions ==

Source material describes a federal parliamentary system with national representation and regional self-government. This draft preserves the constitutional role without hardening every chamber, office, or region count until the five-nation/seven-region issue is reviewed.

== Legacy ==

The constitution gave legal shape to Belcanto's postwar recovery. It also supported language restoration, cultural reconstruction, and the reintegration of communities that had been divided by occupation policy.
